title: Viva Insights: agent query for custom agent adoption reporting in the analyst workbench
summary: Hold: the briefing leaves it unresolved whether the Advanced analysis policy governs the agent query, although Microsoft documents that policy as controlling all advanced analysis features. The roadmap details and query prerequisites are supported; the admin route needs its remaining steps and the command needs its reference citation.
